must_notice: Written operations scope conflicts with product title and possible future innovation
Cash is attractive but not a hard survival need
Staying is a concrete feasible alternative
must_not_assume: A product-sounding title means decision ownership
non_blocking_unknowns: Whether written role can be renegotiated
acceptable_recommendations: Prefer staying or declining the current scope unless written scope changes
Condition acceptance on concrete product responsibility, not on title alone
unacceptable_recommendations: Accept solely for prestige/cash while ignoring stated goals
Treat vague future innovation as a guaranteed transition
action_requirements: Compare actual responsibilities against stated goal
One written scope negotiation; continue current work rather than wait indefinitely
reconsideration_requirements: Written product decision rights or a materially changed cash need can reverse
Stop negotiation by actual acceptance deadline
evidence_requirements: Distinguish supplied personal ratings from objective quality
Use guaranteed cash, not speculative projects
expected_commitment: Strongest justified reversible or conditional recommendation; alternate supported choices allowed
boundary: No exact winner or phrase matching; no outcomes supplied. A formal contract passing does not certify semantics.
